title: Alhambra in 4 hours
text: Our guide, Nacho,  was excellent. Would prefer to receive tickets earlier than day of event.  Alhambra is impressive! Thank you!
author: Curious630379

title: A bit costlier but worth it
text: This was a little pricey but we felt it was definitely worth it.  Alain was our guide.  Very friendly, super knowledgeable and patient.  He clearly loves what he is doing.  He points out little details that I’m pretty sure aren’t covered by some tours.  There were plenty of groups followings “scarves on a stick” with their little headsets on; we didn’t have to fool with any of that.  More time and info in places we wanted to linger.  We felt it was quite worth it.
author: 49bradb49

title: Thoroughly recommend Nacho for Alhambra tour and generally for Spanish context
text: Great private tour of the Alhambra with Nacho who set the historical and cultural context to the extraordinary architecture with authority and enthusiasm and went out of his way to ensure we enjoyed and benefitted.
author: mhanevic

title: Fabulous! (Private tour of the Alhambra)
text: We visited the Alhambra with family (11 people) and in French thanks to Mar, fantastic guide, friendly and very interesting that allowed us to spend a wonderful afternoon on this mythical site that we dreamed of visiting. She managed to captivate adults and children of the family with her information, anecdotes and kindness. We'll all remember it for a long time!
author: Go32701202234

title: Thank you Gabriela ❤️ Thank you Walk in Granada Tours 🤗
text: Our second tour with Gabriela after we had an amazing tour with her on the Historical Tour in November. She gave us another fabulous tour and we cannot recommend her highly enough! She’s extremely knowledgeable, friendly and detailed. Will definitely request her again if we’re in the area and highly recommend her and this tour company ❤️ They are very customer focused and organise super tours of Granada.
author: FarAway708183

title: Amazing Experience
text: This was a truly incredible experience! The beauty and architecture of the Alhambra was unbelievable. In addition to that, the views were jaw-droppingly beautiful. Our tour guide, Rocio, was absolutely sensational - we could not have asked for someone more welcoming, knowledgeable and insightful. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience on this tour, and could not recommend it more.
author: pheobeb375

title: Fascinating guided walk
text:
It was an unusually wet afternoon in Granada, but despite the constant drizzle and cold weather, we had a memorable visit to the Alhambra, thanks to our very knowledgeable and interesting guide Eduardo. 

Edu took time to explain the history of the citadel and then made us aware of many little facts and interesting features. All of us including my teenage kids stayed interested for the full 3 hours. 

Highly recommend this to anyone visiting Granada. It’s a must do!
author: Nupur_M

title: Unforgettable
text: Incredible the Alhambra with very few people and terrific explained by Eduardo Díaz. Thanks for a visit 10. Highly recommended

title: 3 hour guided tour with Granada walk in Tours. Fascinating.
